name: anim_e4_squeezeB
subject: a pink goo Doberman monster lying on top of a pink goo crocodile monster on a sticky paint puddle, with a small black witch cat squashed and buried between their bodies
desc: Loop: the Doberman on top presses down and grinds its broad chest against the cat while the crocodile underneath squeezes up from below, their bodies squishing and bulging; the trapped cat wriggles; thick goo strands stretch, drip and pour down into the sticky floor puddle. Heavy, sticky, viscous.
